summary: Unfortunately not able to finish project as intended. Only works with demo data and no API access. Further implementation of google earth was not possible but a start has been made and concluded in a basic set of python files.
details: The intended use was to overlay currently ongoing hotspots on google earth open maps to give an interactive experience. Then the user could select specific regions/areas to focus on, a sidebar would open up with more information like trends, previous burn areas and rate of spread.
